subject.title: improve: stream native sessions as hosts finish

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose the optional `SessionCatalogListProviderParams.onHost` callback and `sessions.catalog.host` event as the supported plugin/Gateway contract for progressive host catalog delivery?
rationale: This is a compatibility-sensitive public plugin and protocol extension; code review can assess implementation details but cannot determine whether this is the preferred permanent extension boundary without owner intent.

options.title: Approve the progressive contract
options.body: Accept `onHost` plus the scoped event as the canonical extensibility path after a refreshed-head race check and real runtime artifact review.

options.title: Keep progression internal
options.body: Replace the public callback/event contract with an internal owner-specific mechanism if maintainers do not want third-party catalog providers to depend on progressive delivery.

recommendation.title: Approve the progressive contract
recommendation.body: Accept `onHost` plus the scoped event as the canonical extensibility path after a refreshed-head race check and real runtime artifact review.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit history identifies this account as the active implementer of the affected session-catalog design; current-main ownership provenance was unavailable.
